assumptions.chosen: The latest stored package for the task's current head (as the control loop's own latestPackage reads it). Status is the recorded status word exactly ("complete", "incomplete", "blocked", "inconsistent"). The required-criteria line is "{verified} of {total}", where total is the package's recorded number of must-criteria in its scope and verified is the recorded number of those with status Verified (waived ones are not counted as verified). The Verifier line is the package's recorded Verifier status identifier exactly (one of "no_defect_found", "no_defect_found_partial_coverage", "defects", "findings", "unknown", "not_run"), optionally followed by a human-readable label. The package hash is the recorded SHA-256 in full (64 lowercase hex characters).
assumptions.question: Which package is "the evidence package of the task's current head" when several are stored for that head (plan task / integrated scope, gate / done / audit stage), and how are its values written?

assumptions.chosen: In all these cases the card is still present with its heading and shows exactly the text "No evidence package yet." and none of the four values; a package of an earlier head is never shown as the current one.
assumptions.question: What does the card say when the task has no evidence package for its current head, including a task without a head and a task whose only packages belong to earlier heads?

assumptions.chosen: Like the other preview demo data (APP_ENV=preview only, idempotent also on a preview database seeded earlier): demo task T3 gets the demonstration head 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 and one stored evidence package for that head with status "incomplete", 3 must-criteria in scope of which 2 are Verified, Verifier status "not_run", and the recorded package hash ea3524e95164fa82395285b83ee8e5d34a7beced8fd0f31d4c774562be0e5b19. Demo tasks T1 and T2 have no package. Nothing else of the demo data changes.
assumptions.question: What demonstration data does the gate preview carry so the card can be checked?

interface.ui: Sign-in for the gate preview: GET /auth/preview (redirects to / with an owner session). Task page: route /tasks/{id} (reached e.g. from the Demo Project page /projects/demo, where each task's key such as "T3" is shown in a link to /tasks/{id}); page title "Task · Agents" (unchanged). NEW: a card on the task page with heading (h2) exactly "Evidence package" (exactly one such heading on the page). When a package is stored for the task's current head, the card contains a description list with these terms (dt), in this order, each followed by its value (dd): "Status" -> exactly one of "complete", "incomplete", "blocked", "inconsistent"; "Required criteria verified" -> "{verified} of {total}" (e.g. "2 of 3"); "Verifier" -> the recorded Verifier status identifier, one of "no_defect_found", "no_defect_found_partial_coverage", "defects", "findings", "unknown", "not_run" (optionally followed by a human-readable label); "Package hash" -> the full 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 of the package, as visible text (it may wrap). When no package is stored for the current head, or the task has no head, the card shows exactly the text "No evidence package yet." and no description list. The card contains no button, form, text input or select. Preview values (A3 demo data): demo task T3 ("Demo: list descriptions"): Status "incomplete", Required criteria verified "2 of 3", Verifier "not_run", Package hash "ea3524e95164fa82395285b83ee8e5d34a7beced8fd0f31d4c774562be0e5b19"; demo task T1 ("Demo: export a list as CSV"): "No evidence package yet.".

non_goals: Showing the package's other content (criterion-by-criterion statuses, gaps, inconsistencies, regressions, scans, findings, judgments, handoff sections, plan tasks, stage, scope, contract version, head, creation time) - it may be shown but is not required.
Showing packages of earlier heads, a package history, or comparing packages.
Assembling, re-assembling, refreshing, auditing or replaying a package from the UI; any new button, form, action or API under /api/v0.
Changing how packages are built, judged, hashed or stored (src/domain/evidence.ts, src/worker/evidence.ts), the evidence statuses, the gate, the Verifier or the control loop.
Showing the evidence package on other pages (Command page, project pages, Decisions, System).

Changing the existing task page content (header, "Where this task is", the stepper, the owner action card, "Contract", "Verification", "Workers", "Timeline", "Evidence files", "Operations"), its live refresh, sign-in, sessions or authorization.
Estimates, projections, charts, progress indicators or animations.

scope.summary: The task page (/tasks/{id}) gains a read-only card headed "Evidence package" that shows the stored evidence package of the task's current head (the latest package recorded for that head): its status (complete, incomplete, blocked or inconsistent), how many of the package's required (must) criteria are verified out of how many, the recorded result of the independent Verifier, and the package hash. It shows only what the stored package records; opening the page never assembles, stores or changes a package. When no package is recorded for the task's current head (or the task has no head yet), the card says "No evidence package yet.". The gate preview's demonstration data gains one demonstration evidence package on demo task T3 (with a demonstration head) so the card can be checked black-box; demo task T1 keeps having none. All other parts of the task page stay unchanged.
